tap 'What can I help with?': NOT FOUND (it is a heading, not a button), but the screen was unchanged and the text box was there.

open (to reopen the app): same browser-closed error.
close then open: close worked, open still failed with the same error.
open and look once more: same error both times. Stopped here; I never got an answer.
stumbles: The browser the test runs in died about a minute after I sent the question and would not reopen, so I never saw an answer. The error named profile 'ethan' rather than this run's dana-uc5-r2 profile, which suggests the shared browser was killed by amux's wedged-CDP recovery, not by anything Dana did.

verdict: Up to the point of failure the app felt like ChatGPT: one box, one Send, a clear title for my request, and a plain promise that nothing goes out without my OK. The run is inconclusive because the test browser crashed while the answer was being worked on and could not be reopened, so I got no result to judge.
